name: geo-podcast-retrieval-v1
registered_before: any retrieval over this set was run; the queries, the spans and the scoring rules are fixed by this file's first commit

corpus.description: GEO vs SEO podcast, two speakers (Craig, Akshita), two fixed cameras, 7 MXF sources, 3.02 h

ground_truth_mapping.basis: M6 conversation-clock offsets, cross-checked against the captain's Resolve timeline to 0.075 s (docs/SOURCE_MEMORY.md M6); used ONLY to copy a hand-marked moment onto the other angles of the same recording

held_out: no query here was used to tune any threshold: the text floor was calibrated on project 001, the CLIP list on the vep-clip-frame-search queries, the hand candidate generator and the VLM arm on Craig's 'covers his mouth' labels. VP01 asks about a different person and a different statement.

speech.hit: a returned range on an asset overlapping any instance of a relevant moment, each padded by the tolerance
speech.recall: relevant moments with at least one instance hit / relevant moments
speech.precision: returned ranges that hit / returned ranges
speech.abstention: a query with no relevant moment is correct when nothing is retained above the floor

visual.spans: each positive grid frame becomes [t-5, t+5]; adjacent ones merge; ambiguous frames neither count for nor against
visual.precision: returned ranges whose best frame lies in a positive span / returned ranges that do not lie wholly in an ambiguous span
visual.recall: positive spans touched by a returned range / positive spans
visual.abstention: an absent query is correct only if nothing is returned; a refused query is correct when expect=refused

person.recall: seconds of ground truth covered by returned spans (padded by the tolerance) / seconds of ground truth
person.precision: seconds of returned spans covered by ground truth (padded) / seconds of returned spans, inside the scored window
person.window_speaking: the union of both speakers' turns, each padded by 1.0 s, per asset

verified_predicate.recall: events overlapped by a YES span / events
verified_predicate.precision_strict: YES spans overlapping an event / YES spans inside the window
verified_predicate.precision_lenient: YES spans overlapping an event or an ambiguous event / YES spans inside the window
